NASA is offering one million dollars for bold ideas to build a permanent Moon base, but what if a lunar city became visible from your backyard? If humans construct habitats using 3D-printed lunar soil, looking up through home binoculars could reveal glowing human structures on the dark moonscape. Highly reflective solar panels and glass domes would bounce sunlight straight back to Earth, creating artificial stars. Would you look up every night to spot human lights on another world? Follow for more what-ifs.
